Flags.Note: Segments are ranked by EPDO density \(EPDO points per mile per year\) in descending order\. The HIN is defined as the set of top\-ranked segments that together \(a\) account for at least 65% of all matched K\+A crashes and \(b\) represent no more than 10% of network segments\. In practice, 5\.0% of segments were sufficient to capture 90\.4% of K\+A crashes\.
